subject.title: I updated Scrapling and the skill became hidden again

question: Does the latest Scrapling release contain a valid high-impact or malicious finding that requires hiding, or should staff clear it as a recurring false positive and correct the triggering rule or state transition?
rationale: The public listing proves the block, but only private scanner evidence, moderation events, and prior restoration history can safely distinguish an intentional security hold from a defect.

options.title: Clear and prevent recurrence
options.body: Unhide and rescan through the audited staff flow, then correct the narrow scanner or moderation-state cause if the release is safe.

options.title: Uphold the security hold
options.body: Keep the release hidden and provide the publisher a bounded actionable explanation of the finding and recovery expectations.

recommendation.title: Clear and prevent recurrence
recommendation.body: Unhide and rescan through the audited staff flow, then correct the narrow scanner or moderation-state cause if the release is safe.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior structured-moderation work is most directly connected to the evidence required for this decision.
